Name: Custom Farm
Author: NagtNp
Description:
To use the mod just choose which farm to use, the two files in the Farm.xnb and FarmMOD.xnb folder
To use Farm.xnb, just replace the file in the Stardew Valley Content Maps folder (recommend doing a buckup before replacing)
recommended to use FarmMOD.xnb in case of error in the fences, remember to delete the MOD to stay only Farm.xnb (this error happens through texture mods among others) Using the Farm.Mod you remove the fences and the hay that in my test they gave an error.
